instruction: A warehouse starts with 1579 boxes. It receives 3 deliveries of 39 boxes each. It ships 21 boxes per day for 4 days. It receives 3 deliveries of 26 boxes each. How many boxes does it have at the end? Compute it with the bash tool (python3 -c). Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory.
